name: The Friendly Giant
summary: Small ISP + web design (giant.net.au, by Jessie Pitt, ~1998); defunct (THE FRIENDLY GIANT PTY LTD, ACN 077 546 626).

events.details: Defunct. Death neither c.2002 (ISP page ran to Feb 2015) nor c.2022 ABN date; the retail ISP page vanished between Feb 2015 and May 2017 - c. 2016.

refs.label: Classic ISP homepage (unchanged since 2002) still served Feb 2015.
By May 2017 the site is purely a computer-repair shop (FergTech era), ISP offerings gone.
Company deregistered Apr 2022 - admin end, after ISP retail had already ceased.
Domain still live today as a computer-repair business with legacy webmail links; non-ISP survival does not extend ISP death.
ABR: THE FRIENDLY GIANT PTY LTD ACN 077 546 626
